title: SICA:置信下界选择(移植)
note: SICA 选择规则的移植版:沿用本地 CLB 数学,有可用 CI 时将选中的历史 round 写入 step.incumbent_round。平台负责测量与停止预算;具体数学及历史源码恢复方面的偏差见 deviations。

deviations.what: The platform owns candidate measurement and the stopping budget; normal returns record the selected historical round as step.incumbent_round when its comparison bound has an available CI.
deviations.why: main() reports one step through editor.report_many, the editor API that supports incumbent_round. _worth_continuing is diagnostic only; no-change and unusable proposals explicitly keep stop=False. This records the selection separately from candidate scores while the platform decides what to measure and when to stop.

deviations.what: The existing CLB math is preserved and differs from upstream.
deviations.why: sica/runner.py:118-135 uses the highest target_score iteration's ci_lower and accepts means >= that bound. _select_base instead maximizes ci_lower, uses >, and returns the bound holder if nothing clears it. _ci_lower falls back to the score when no numeric lower interval endpoint exists. This fix records that selector's result without changing its math.

deviations.what: An unavailable comparison CI leaves incumbent_round unspecified rather than asserting a fallback kept round.
deviations.why: _incumbent_fields requires a finite, ordered two-endpoint score_ci95 on the bound holder and a valid selected round. Missing history, unavailable CI, or an invalid round is explained in method_reported.sica_rule.incumbent_reason. Upstream sica/runner.py:107-114 instead defaults to iteration 0 when score tables or statistics are empty. The existing selector and its prompt fallback remain unchanged.

deviations.what: The selected historical round is recorded and named in the prompt, but its source snapshot is not restored for editing.
deviations.why: main() continues to pass request.base_harness to editor.ask and editor.apply_edits. The edit uses the shared platform editor rather than SICA's full per-iteration improvement machinery; incumbent_round records the choice but does not itself switch the tree being edited.
